meta.instagramCaption:
🤔 IPO ke 4 sawaal jo har beginner puchta hai! Save kar lo 📌

1️⃣ GMP kya hai?
Grey market ka unofficial rate. Guarantee nahi, sirf ek rumor jaisa indicator.

2️⃣ Allotment na mile toh paisa?
Paisa kata nahi hota, sirf block hota hai (ASBA). Allotment na mile toh listing se pehle apne aap unblock ho jata hai.

3️⃣ Listing day pe bechein ya hold karein?
Ye aapke goal pe depend karta hai: jaldi listing gain ya long-term growth. Hype ya GMP dekh ke decide mat karo.

4️⃣ SME ya mainboard?
SME me minimum application ₹2 lakh se zyada hota hai, liquidity kam aur risk zyada. Mainboard retail me minimum aam taur par ₹15,000 ke aas-paas hota hai.

📝 Update: SEBI ne SME IPO ka minimum ₹1 lakh karne ka proposal diya hai, par abhi ye final rule nahi hai.

Aapka sabse bada IPO sawaal kya hai? Comment me batao 👇
Aur ye reel us dost ko bhejo jo pehli baar IPO me apply karne wala hai 🔥

Follow @techwith.GenZ for daily market aur tech updates.

⚠️ Disclaimer: Ye sirf educational information hai, investment advice nahi. Invest karne se pehle apna research karo ya SEBI-registered advisor se salah lo.
